page.layout: One page of running text, with headings and paragraphs in one column. No margin notes. Continuation of the previous paragraph at the top, a rule, then a level 1 heading with a level 2 subtitle, then italic question headings alternating with paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: adhibitis, & sua voluntate coram eis nücupata, sciat hoc perfectissimum testamentum jure civili, firmumq; constitutum. §. final. inst. cod.
main_text.head: De militari testamento. Von der Kriegsleut[?] testament.

head.i: Estne supra dicta diligens observatio in ordinandis testamentis, militibus propter nimiam imperi-tiam eorum constitutionibus prin-cipalibus remissa?

main_text.p: EST, nam quanvis ij neq; legitimum numerum testium adhibuerint, neq; aliam testamentorum solennitatem observaverint, Der testamenten Sier-ligkeit halten: rectè nihilominus testantur, videlicet cum in expeditionibus occupati sunt. in princip. in-stitut.cod.

head.i: Quid autem si non sunt in castris aut expeditionibus?

main_text.p: Illis temporibus, per quæ citra expeditionum ne-cessitatem in aliis locis vel suis ædibus degunt: mi-nimè ad vendicandum tale privilegium adjuvantur: sed testari quidem, etsi filiifamiliarum sint, propter militiam conceduntur: iure tamè communi eadem observatione & in eorum testamentis adhibenda, quam in testamentis paganorum proximè expofui-mus. §. illis autem inst. cod.
Quinimò & mutus & surdus miles testamentum facere potest. §. quinimò. inst. cod.

page.notes: The initial E of "EST" is a large drop cap, joined to the word. The black letter words "Kriegsleut" (title) and "Der testamenten Sierligkeit halten" (body) are uncertain in their exact letters; the first is marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "Sier-ligkeit" and "in-stitut" is a line-end break; the printed "inst.tut" has a space inside it, which I read as "instit.ut" with a break. "Titulus?" and the question headings are italic and centred. The catchword "QVIS" is the start of the next heading, set in italic and underlined. Printing errors such as "Der" and "Von" in black letter were left as printed.
